image_description: A close-up view of an ornate, historical metal breastplate (cuirass). The armor is made of polished steel with significant gilding and etched decorative patterns. It features a central vertical ridge, embossed floral or heraldic motifs, and rows of brass rivets along the shoulder straps and side edges. The surface shows signs of age and patina but remains highly reflective.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar objects like shields or plastrons using ImageNet-level features.
To analyze the complex interaction of light on the etched vs. polished surfaces for any AI-generated texture inconsistencies or 'melting' artifacts.
To verify the structural integrity of the riveted edges and ensure no floating elements or boundary bleeding between the armor and background.

focus_areas: Consistency of specular highlights on curved metal surfaces
Structural logic of rivet placement and edge binding
Clarity and coherence of etched decorative patterns
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Verify if the etched patterns maintain consistent line width and depth perception. Check if the reflections on the curved surface align with a single light source direction. Ensure the rivets appear physically attached rather than painted on.
